reviews.t: I thought it was great. It didn't really feel cheap like I thought ...
reviews.x: When I first opened it, I thought it was great. It didn't really feel cheap like I thought it would. It works relatively well on my feet. I mostly use it on the heels of my feet. When I try to used it on the middle part of the soles it doesn't work too well. You have to lightly go over where you want to use the product. When you press hard it stops.

reviews.t: Great product/
reviews.x: This has worked amazingly for my feet.  My feet are no longer rough and an embarrassment.  The only drawback is sometimes the head does not come on so I have to tap it, but I still would not exchange it.  This thing is very simple to use.  I use it after soaking my foot in a listerine/vinegar soak and my feet always end up so so smooth.  In my opinion this works just as well as the $50+ files.

reviews.t: Wish you could use a little more pressure. You ...
reviews.x: Wish you could use a little more pressure. You put hardly any pressure on it and it stops. I know it's a safety function, but it doesn't remove anything on your feet because You cant press down on your heel!

reviews.t: Awesome tool
reviews.x: Love this item...l prefer to do my own pedicure as i'm not sure how clean some places are and this is a great tool

reviews.t: 1st time out worked good, burns through batteries quickly wish it was a ...
reviews.x: 1st time out worked good, burns through batteries quickly wish it was a plug in unit instead. Got what I paid for

reviews.t: Great pedi file!
reviews.x: This is a great pedi-file. Much cheaper than the name-brand and it works great! Would purchase again.

reviews.t: Bought 2nd one and it is terrible!!!!!!!!!
reviews.x: I first purchased a Pedi-Egg brand foot file at Walmart for $15; thinking I got a bargain. Wrong!! It did not perform anywhere near as well as this one! This thing gives you a soft, smooth pedicure like you'd have professionally done  I bought another one of these, as I was going to give as a gift; and it is terrible!! This one (looks identical in same packaging) makes an awful noise, as if motor is strained, and it turns in reverse. You have to flip it over in your hand, uncomfortable; because

reviews.t: First one didn't work on arrival; second one works fine
reviews.x: Edit: The company emailed and asked if I liked the product and I told them it was broken on arrival and I was sending it back to Amazon. They offered to send me a new one for free with some additional foot cream. I accepted and the second one came in and works perfectly. They stated they never resend returned material and eluded to Amazon being the culprit. Not sure who to believe but I got the product and am happy with this one so I doesn't really matter in the long run I guess.  Initial review

reviews.t: Smoother feet and a happier me
reviews.x: I was skeptical of the product at first. Mainly because my feet are so bad and nothing else worked. I tried this because a friend recommended electric callus removers. After a couple sessions of being gentle on the bottoms of the feet, I could definitely feel a difference in the texture and smoothness of my feet. It was one of those "why didn't I get this earlier" type of product. I am happy that I've found this product.

reviews.t: Paid for itself
reviews.x: Very pleased. Paid for itself the first time I used it today. Worked very well to gently remove a huge callous on my toe.  I usually pay the podiatrist forty dollars to take five minutes and shave it off with a scapel.  Of course I didnt go all the way to the good skin but it is smooth and no longer hurting. Well worth the price. Now I will be able to keep it off.  Just follow the directions and be gentle and it works.

reviews.t: Love this little device!  It's a multi-tasker!
reviews.x: Best invention ever!  Almost.  This little thing not only files off some pretty hard callouses, but also does a FANTASTIC job on toenails!  I loved it so much that I've given one to my mom, my dad, and my spouse and they are all raving at how easy this is to use.  Great gift for anyone (especially seniors) experiencing foot problems that need help getting to their toenails.  Delivery was very fast and nicely packaged.

reviews.t: Thank you for rewarding my laziness!
reviews.x: Not gonna lie to you perfect strangers I'm lazy. I used to work that pumice stone and just give up because my feet get callused pretty badly in the summer. I just whip this guy out and boom it takes about 30 seconds for what used to be 10+ minutes of hard scrubbing. The best part is you can use this wet or dry. So if you miss a small spot you don't have to re-soak your feet to soften them. I love this product!

reviews.t: Does a great job, not very durable
reviews.x: I have some bad looking ankles. This did the trick! I would have to do it every day if I wanted to keep them looking good, but hey, I'm on my feet a lot too. Not very durable. I accidentally dropped it on my carpet and so now if I turn it all but upright then it shuts down and doesn't work until I turn it upright again. I loved it while it was still working.

reviews.t: Weak; Not the Best.
reviews.x: This is good for slightly softening thick calluses but does nothing to even out the surface of your skin if it's uneven or peeling. The grinding power is weak; when you turn it on and hold it against your foot, putting slight to moderate pressure on it stops the mechanism entirely. Wouldn't recommend; just get a pumice stone! It works much better.

reviews.t: GREAT PRODUCT!!  BUY THIS!!
reviews.x: I have had embarrassing dry, calloused heels my entire life.  I have tried everything.  The only thing that ever worked was having the nail salon people shave the skin off.  This is WAY BETTER, cheaper, more hygienic, and safer.  This is the only product that has ever given noticeable, lasting results at home.  It's great!!  5 stars!!

reviews.t: Love it
reviews.x: For my review I received a discount for my item which did not affect my opinion or my review. I have very dry feet because I always wear sandals and this was the perfect tool to get rid of all the hard parts of my foot I just wish that I could plug it in instead of having to buy batteries

reviews.t: Just what I've been looking for
reviews.x: This tech pedi is just what I have been searching for. I was using a ped egg and only used it about once a month. But it was time consuming and I tried to do it as fast as I could after I would shower and dry my feet off. This is fast, easy and effortless. Also does a great job.

reviews.t: Lost its power after a few charges and now moves so slowly
reviews.x: Worked well the first few times...but then started winding down like it needs more power. I always charged it, but it is so weak now --- the roller moves so slowly that it is hardly useful. I am now looking for another product to replace this one. So disappointed.

reviews.t: Stopped working shortly after I got it.
reviews.x: This is a great product when it worked. I used it twice and the third time it work cut on and off. I assume it has a short in it. Sometimes it will come on, but not stay on. I have given up on it. I wish I had returned it when it first started acting up.

reviews.t: Stopped working after using a couple of times
reviews.x: Bought it for my Mom. Though the product does what it is supposed to do and shows immediate results, it stopped working after a  couple of uses. We couldn't return it within 30 days as she was not using it every 2-3 weeks. Very unhappy with the product.

reviews.t: it works
reviews.x: Couldn't wait to try this. After reading other comments I definitely followed some advice. Use with a light hand! Roller is pretty fast so I fumbled a bit at first. I really like this product. My heels aren't real bad so a little use went a long way

reviews.t: I LOVE this thing
reviews.x: I LOVE this thing! People who say they can't put any pressure on it before it stops didn't read the directions.  It's really gross seeing how much comes off your feet, but my feet look and feel a lot better!

reviews.t: good choice.
reviews.x: I bought 2 and they do exactly what they are supposed to. The first time my girlfriend used it she said that she wished it worked faster but I think if it did they would rip into her foot. Makes a great gift

reviews.t: Happy feet
reviews.x: I found the Nature Tech to be very easy to use and I was quite happy with the results and the product in general was such a good price that I couldn't pass it up. Thanks and hope it continues to do the job!

reviews.t: Does the trick!
reviews.x: This item does the trick for removing callous, but is not as powerful as I would have liked. It takes a long time to remove thick callous and gets hot on my foot (due to friction from sanding callous).

claims.text: Many reviewers say it works very well, leaving feet smooth and soft and removing calluses effectively.
Several reviewers find it easy and quick to use, saving time compared to manual filing.
A common complaint is that it stops or shuts down under even slight pressure, limiting how much it can grind.
Some reviewers note durability and battery issues, including burning through batteries quickly and breaking after a drop.
A few reviewers mention receiving a defective unit on arrival, though at least one had it replaced by the company.
